stage: qualification pilot; not a repeated timing estimate
build_volume: C: NVMe SSD; D: and E: HDD excluded from measured build paths
upstream: Upstream opt-dist windows-ci PGO sequence and Microsoft link.exe/lib.exe
local: Same corpus/configuration plus static-LLVM training relink and lld-link/llvm-lib
thinlto: No added ThinLTO in either variant: LLVM off; rustc thin-local, not cross-crate thin
common_deviations_from_official_infrastr: Dedicated 16-LP self-hosted runner instead of upstream eight-CPU release runner
Fresh isolated Cargo home and no compiler cache; not upstream private remote-cache performance
Pinned full dist configuration invoked directly, avoiding upstream wrappers that uninstall global tools
Bootstrap-only clang-runtime discovery fix in both variants
Training fixture lockfile format migration with unchanged package graph
required_outputs: Full stable distribution including docs, tools, MSI and selected backends; identical artifact-name sets
qualification: Unmodified upstream opt-dist extracted-distribution tests; no omitted tests or waived failures
required_profile_evidence: Both generated profiles used in final compiler; record backend coverage for both and require nonzero lowering/InstCombine counters for local
production_endpoint: Helper plus fresh PGO, full compilation and packaging; excludes setup, extracted-distribution tests and uploads
whole_job_endpoint: GitHub job start to completion, including setup, qualification, preservation and experiment-owned build cleanup
downstream_endpoint: Paired offline cold five-command IronRDP native wall time; existing qualified shipping/control comparison remains separate until fresh artifacts are replayed
acceptance: No percentage CI-cost claim until both releases qualify with identical tools/configuration apart from the declared intervention
pilot_limit: One fresh pair establishes feasibility and observed cost only; reverse-order repetitions required before claiming a stable CI effect
failure_policy: Retain evidence, stop dependent candidate if baseline fails, never substitute timeout duration or no-PGO baseline
cleanup: Only this run's generated source/build directory, after successful evidence and full-distribution upload; source, profiles and local evidence retained
